text: Samsung PRISM is a technology innovation program focused on research, engineering, and problem solving. Streaming Live RAG allows an AI system to retrieve information while a user's request is still being spoken or developed. A retrieval controller decides whether the system should WAIT for more information, RETRIEVE relevant information, or SUPPRESS retrieval for irrelevant or conversational input. Multi-intent decomposition breaks a single natural-language request into multiple distinct retrieval queries. Evidence fusion combines results from multiple retrieval queries into a unified evidence set. Session-aware synthesis uses information from the current conversation session to refine previous answers when the user provides additional details.
